dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: I'd like to think I'm a flexible guy who can adapt to any environment, never mind one as pleasant as this.

choices.text: Well, the layout is my pride and joy.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Some people like to go out and have fun. Others prefer to create a comfy space for themselves at home where they can enjoy some peace and quiet.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: People enjoy life in different ways, but both approaches are equally valid.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: You know, this place is real roomy. There are houses and buildings, sure... But, there's also lots of open space...

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: You could build a bunch of different areas, each with a unique design. That way, it'd feel like we were camping in a new place every night!

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: I'd even help out if you wanted!

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Truth is, I'm fully furnished with ideas as we speak!

choices.text: This is rather embarrassing. I've neglected the place lately...

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: No, no, no! Don't say that!

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: I prefer being out adventuring too, so I try to keep things simple at home. But even then, my pad isn't nearly as neat as this.
